headline: WSN @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.50 at BAL 5.17, with a projected total of 9.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: WSN moved -0.07 runs while BAL moved +0.70, changing the projected margin by -0.77 runs. The projected total climbed +0.63, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Andrew Alvarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, Taylor Ward, Dylan Crews, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Wood because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
